subject: Remove unused opposite-host construction from hosted database qualification
claim: Six hosted construction sites per host now package only the image that the behavior owner executes. Windows HostStorage and dependent HostRootWriter passed in a 137140 ms command, compared with the previous 234129 ms observation (41.4% lower). Debian HostStorage passed with an 80000 ms step. All selected recovery, reopen, and interruption assertions remain. No complete database qualification or general performance threshold is claimed.

source.value: Worktree based on cad7506e. Windows script SHA-256 e4d3b0ed42079497e67018f1d9407600805353d6fa688a07ef28deea772fcf66; Linux script SHA-256 03446a38403051e71c89ab32c300e1251031a563b181c7df2324aae525a746a9.

runs.target: Before: one source construction but both host packages; HostStorage 129620 ms and HostRootWriter 103860 ms
runs.command: Tools\Native\Test-Database-Storage.cmd --qualification-step HostRootWriter (240-second outer bound; prior evidence)

runs.target: After: current-host products; HostStorage 78060 ms and HostRootWriter 58300 ms, including prerequisite ordering and recovery behaviors

runs.host: Local WSL Debian, Node 20.19.2; repository on /mnt/d/windvale/dev01
runs.target: After: current-host HostStorage behavior; step 80000 ms; complete WSL command including startup 92952 ms
runs.command: wsl --distribution Debian --cd /mnt/d/windvale/dev01 -- bash -lc "timeout --kill-after=5s 180s bash Tools/Native/Test-Database-Storage.sh --qualification-step HostStorage"

runs.target: Construction ownership guard, exact pipeline inventory after deletion, and all existing routing checks (31 general and 280 native cases)

limitations: The pass covers the named focused runs only. Complete 57-case database qualification, remaining hosted cases, and complete paired-host repository qualification were not run: they exceed the ten-minute development budget and the causal scope of this removal.

The before observation overlapped other verification; the after host runs were sequential. Retained qualified tools and fresh qualification products were used. The observed improvement is not a controlled clean-machine benchmark or an enforceable regression threshold. There is no completed before Debian timing for this change.

Opposite-host image construction is delegated to the existing console-packager-container-reconstruction and console-segmented-construction owners; malformed hosted-container behavior remains with hosted-console-container-mutations. Those unchanged packager owners were inspected but not executed in this run. Both host database behavior lanes are still required for complete qualification.

The removed images were never executed by the host that constructed them. Per-database cross-construction coverage is deliberately removed; current-host database behavior and focused generic packager coverage replace that repetition. Common host-adapter assembly A/B comparisons and the paired StorageLowering case remain.
Peak child-process memory was not measured. No claim is made that overall qualification meets its target; repeated construction across distinct products remains redesign work.

An initial routing-verifier attempt rejected stale pipeline-count expectations after the deletion. Updating the expected removal of two admission, ten link, and twelve hosted-package call sites resolved that inventory failure; the recorded rerun passed.
